notes.title: Minor Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue with corrupted save files crashing the game

notes.title: Small QOL update
notes.content:
Hey all, just some small quality of life updates and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Can now see grid numbers when hovering your mouse over an empty grid space
[*] Added small popup when hovering over units so you can quickly see their damage/health stats without needing to right click for info
[*] Highlighted rules text on card info to clearly separate it from flavor text
[*] Fixed Pyromancer’s Rest effect (now heals 2 damage + removes negative effects)
[*] Fixed bug on upgrade screen where double clicking perks or boons crashed the game
[*] Added option to view main menu on upgrade screen so you can see your current deck/perks when making card choices
[*] Fixed bug where mouse cursor would occasionally disappear
[/list]
